physicalNotes: Radius 0.508 +/- 0.016 solar radii from Kossakowski et al. 2021, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of TOI-1201 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2021A&A...656A.124K/abstract): 353,416 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 0.512 +/- 0.02 solar masses from Kossakowski et al. 2021, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of TOI-1201 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2021A&A...656A.124K/abstract); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 3476 +/- 51 K from Kossakowski et al. 2021, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of TOI-1201 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2021A&A...656A.124K/abstract). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
